_about: Machine families: what a trained network's class neurons mean, and where
the network is built. A machine names its family; the console, the
diagnosis and the reports read class names from here, never from a
pump-shaped constant. Class 0 is always healthy. Networks are build
tests/test_families.py checks each list against its simulator's fault modes.

wizard: what the commissioning wizard asks for a machine of the family, and the feature lines it writes into the machine's profile; {teeth}, {teeth2} (twice the teeth) and the bearing's own defect orders {ftf}, {bpfo}, {bpfi}, {bsf}, {bsf2} (all derived from the machine's bearing geometry) are filled in per machine.

derived: numbers computed from the machine's own (its parameters, rpm and the bearing's defect orders ftf/bpfo/bpfi/bsf/bsf2) with + - * / only, for the order templates; demo: the family's simulated reference machine in the console.

step (optional, default 1): the spacing of a parameter's sensible values (a motor's poles come in pairs), used only when try mode moves an assumed value to fit the visitor's speed. public_label (optional): the name the public Try-it page shows instead of label; wizard parameters not given there take their default, and the report lists them as assumed.
